cycle_mechanic.text: Cambridge has more cyclists for its size than anywhere else in Britain. About half the people who live here ride to work or college, and the other half are walking a bike with a flat.
Every bike here has had at least four owners and been stolen twice. The basket stays with the bike. The basket knows things.

cycle_customer.text: Third bell this term. Someone keeps nicking them. Not the bike, the bell. There's a bell thief at large and the police are not as interested as I'd like.
